description: This file defines the 'Request' class within the OpenCart System Library namespace, which handles HTTP request data such as GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER variables. It provides methods for constructing and sanitizing request data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request and provides methods to access and sanitize request data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object by cleaning global $_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, and $_SERVER variables.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Sanitizes input data by recursively trimming and encoding special characters, or directly escaping strings.
